title: Genomic DNA Extraction from Animal Faecal Tissues Using DNeasy Kit
author: Somasundhari Shanmuganandam
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6bbhain

steps.title: Thaw samples
steps.instruction: Thaw the faecal tissue samples on ice and then bring them to room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare tissue with beads
steps.instruction: Using a scalpel, cut exactly 50 mg of tissue, confirm the weight, and place it into a 2 ml Eppendorf tube that already contains 0.5 cm of purified silica beads.

steps.title: Add lysis reagents
steps.instruction: Add 324 µl Buffer ATL and 36 µl Proteinase K to each bead tube. For a reagent‑only control, use an empty bead tube and add only Buffer ATL and Proteinase K.

steps.title: Mechanical disruption
steps.instruction: Place the bead tubes in a bead beater and run 2 × 20 seconds, then spin the tubes down briefly.

steps.title: Incubate for lysis
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at 56 °C in a heat block for 10 – 30 minutes, adjusting the time according to the degree of tissue lysis.

steps.title: RNase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 4 µl RNase A (100 mg ml⁻¹) to each lysed sample, vortex, and incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Vortex the lysates, then transfer as much supernatant as possible (up to 200 µl) into a new 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube and discard the pellet. Tiny tissue fragments may remain and will be lysed in the next step.

steps.title: Add binding reagents
steps.instruction: Add binding reagents to the transferred supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µl Buffer AL and vortex.
Immediately add 200 µl ethanol, pipette up and down, and vortex.

steps.title: Load spin column
steps.instruction: Transfer the entire contents of the tube onto the spin column supplied with the kit.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the column at 6,000 rcf for 1 minute. Discard the flow‑through and the collection tube.

steps.title: Wash with AW1
steps.instruction: Place a new collection tube beneath the column, add 500 µl Buffer AW1, centrifuge at 6,000 rcf for 1 minute, then discard the flow‑through and collection tube.

steps.title: Wash with AW2
steps.instruction: Place a new collection tube beneath the column, add 500 µl Buffer AW2, and centrifuge at maximum speed (13,000 rcf) for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Dry spin
steps.instruction: Discard the flow‑through, replace the same collection tube, and centrifuge at maximum speed (13,000 rcf) for 1 minute.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Place a fresh 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube under the column, add 100 µl Buffer AE, let stand for 1 minute, then centrifuge at 6,000 rcf for 1 minute to collect eluate.

steps.title: Re‑elution
steps.instruction: Add the eluated DNA back onto the same column for a second elution.

steps.title: Store DNA
steps.instruction: Discard the spin column. Store 50 µl of the eluate at 4 °C for immediate quantitative analysis and store the remaining eluate at –20 °C to avoid repeated freeze‑thaw cycles.

steps.title: Agarose gel check
steps.instruction: Prepare a 0.8 % agarose gel and run the DNA at 100 V for 40–45 minutes to assess extraction quality.

steps.title: Qubit standardisation
steps.instruction: Ensure the Qubit fluorometer is calibrated before use.

steps.title: Qubit DNA quantification
steps.instruction: Using the Qubit Broad‑Range DNA assay kit, mix 1 µl of extracted DNA with the assay reagents, read the fluorescence, and record the concentration (ng µl⁻¹).

substeps.instruction: Prepare a blank with 2 µl distilled water.
Prepare a standard with 2 µl Buffer AE.
Clean the assay surface between each read.

steps.title: Nanodrop measurement
steps.instruction: Apply 2 µl of the DNA sample to the Nanodrop pedestal, read the absorbance, clean the surface before the next measurement, and record A260/280, A260/230, and concentration (ng µl⁻¹).
